_about: Parameters for the live step (postings and gate H1). The author decided the three marked 'author, 2026-10-19' (Pacific time) (course/2026fa/submissions/aravindkumar2504/mode-build/author-decisions.md); allow_senior is still the assistant's proposal. None is a measured fact.

max_postings_per_company.why: One posting per company keeps the human review at gates H1 and H2 short and spreads the check across companies.

max_postings_total.why: Eight postings is about 20 to 30 minutes of careful reading, spread over eight companies.

allow_senior.why: The candidate has not started work yet, so senior, staff, principal and lead titles are set aside; a company with only senior backend postings is reported as such, not checked.

exclude_title_patterns.why: Contract and temporary roles rarely come with H-1B sponsorship, and a PhD-only role is not open to a master's graduate; the first rehearsal picked one of each.
